newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Enterprises IPO forms still being counted.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Enterprises IPO forms still being counted.

text.p: A deluge of application forms for Beijing Enterprises Holdings Ltd's Hong Kong initial public offering was still being counted on Saturday morning after the offering closed at noon on Friday, a Peregrine spokesman said.

"They are still counting. They counted until the wee (early) hours and then they stopped and they restarted," said Tom Grimmer, a spokesman for Peregrine Capital Ltd, one of the global coordinators of the share issue.
He said the count should be completed later on Saturday.
Red chip conglomerate Beijing Enterprises is expected to smash Hong Kong initial public offering records, with a subscription level of 1,000 to 1,500 times, analysts said.
The company, controlled by the Beijing municipal government, offered 150 million shares in a global initial public offering.
Ten percent was offered in Hong Kong and 90 percent to international investors.
